answers.reasoning: ①Lacked should be Lacking — participle clause needs present participle
④comparing should be compared — mining rush is compared (passive), not comparing (active)
②which should be when — 'at the age of 36 when he drowned', temporal adverbial needs when
④ecological should be economic — 'Despite the economic benefits' not ecological
④careless is opposite of careful — he advocated for careful management
